595b06840b87c458.title: Film Club — In-Person Program
595b06840b87c458.desc: The legendary Marx Brothers shine in this delightful and chaotic comedy. After being appointed the dictator of Freedonia, Rufus T. Firefly proceeds to bring the mythical nation to a halt by showing up late and insulting everyone at his inauguration. Hoping to oust the unfit new leader, two spies are sent from the neighboring Sylvania. Soon enough, war is declared between the two nations with outrageous results. Including Groucho's famous mirror scene and final battle scene, it remains as entertaining and relevant today as when first released in 1933. This film is not rated. This film screening is made possible by the generosity of Los Amigos of East Los Angeles Library. Light refreshments are also provided courtesy of Los Amigos.

59311cbc667874be.desc: Join in for yoga, a restorative sound bath, and a wellness vendor social where you can connect, shop, and enjoy food and beverages. It’s the perfect opportunity to slow down, recharge, and welcome the season with mindful movement and community. Whether you’re new to yoga or a seasoned yogi, this experience is designed for all levels. You’ll enjoy a thoughtfully curated two-hour experience led by talented instructors.
